title: Abstract Wine Bottle
description: An abstract painting featuring a stylized wine bottle in the center, rendered with flat pink, orange, and white shapes against a background divided into soft pink on the left and muted blue tones on the right. Visible brushstrokes, drips, and geometric color blocks create a modern, fragmented composition.
prompt: abstract painting of a stylized wine bottle centered on canvas, rendered in flat areas of bright pink, orange, and white with geometric shapes and black details, set against a divided background of soft pink on the left and cool blue tones on the right, visible expressive brushstrokes, paint drips, and textured color fields in a modern contemporary style
